goal: Test whether a fixed generalized wordmark style description yields a coherent real new-four-character image relative to neutral baseline without per-character prompt optimization.
shared_output_contract: 请直接生成一张独立的图片，只输出图片，不解释。16:9横幅，背景必须真正透明。画面中央只有准确的四个简体中文字「溪桥听雨」，从左到右单行排列，深墨黑色，结构清晰易认、无错字漏笔。禁止任何额外文字、拼音、编号、分栏、边框、插画、山水、风景、纹理、阴影、拼贴和设计讲解板。

generic_grammar.source: R12 authored designer-stage evidence -> R20 whole-word hypotheses -> R23 demonstrated single-word style difference. This is a human-authored generic prompt specification, not extracted executable font model.
generic_grammar.freeze_boundary: Generalized AFTER viewing R23 but BEFORE any R24 carrier output; withheld R24 wording was already specified at R23.
generic_grammar.scope: ALL 4-HANZI WORDMARKS WITHOUT NAMING ANY PARTICULAR CHARACTER

conditions.decision: Preserve original semantic stroke topology; if a style edit risks an ambiguous character, revert the edit

conditions.if: a glyph is visually denser than its neighbors
conditions.decision: Protect enclosed inner negative spaces, temper excess solid black without replacing the glyph with abstract graphics
Allow one original structural dominant stroke to hold visual weight without globally thickening the font

conditions.if: genuine surrounding frame or left-right component
conditions.decision: Keep inside blank legible for enclosure; keep component relationship clear for left-right; avoid fusion that changes meaning
Use a restrained directional brush rhythm in at most 1-2 structurally justified main strokes; others stay compact, avoid same tail repeated per glyph
Balance perceived weight, visual baseline, character size and inter-character spacing; assess as a single brand mark
conditions.reject: one isolated oversized eye-catcher or drifting baseline

A.name: A
A.full_prompt:
请直接生成一张独立的图片，只输出图片，不解释。16:9横幅，背景必须真正透明。画面中央只有准确的四个简体中文字「溪桥听雨」，从左到右单行排列，深墨黑色，结构清晰易认、无错字漏笔。禁止任何额外文字、拼音、编号、分栏、边框、插画、山水、风景、纹理、阴影、拼贴和设计讲解板。
采用标准、端正、规整的宋体印刷字风格，笔画与间距均衡，四字视觉高度一致。不制作手写连笔、共笔、夸张长笔、个性化曲线或装饰。这只是便于辨认的中性文字基准。

B.name: B
B.full_prompt:
请直接生成一张独立的图片，只输出图片，不解释。16:9横幅，背景必须真正透明。画面中央只有准确的四个简体中文字「溪桥听雨」，从左到右单行排列，深墨黑色，结构清晰易认、无错字漏笔。禁止任何额外文字、拼音、编号、分栏、边框、插画、山水、风景、纹理、阴影、拼贴和设计讲解板。
采用有统一识别性的现代中文艺术字标，而不是默认字体：整组为克制、流动、略带古典的书写气质，四字的字重、间距、基线和墨迹外轮廓相互平衡。按各字真实构形有条件设计：复杂密集处优先保留内部白口、减少拥堵；疏朗结构仅选择一处原生主笔适当增强；包围结构不能堵塞内腔，左右结构不能混淆部件。在整组最多让一至两处结构合理的主笔形成含蓄、相互呼应的流动笔势，其余笔画克制收束；绝不每个字机械添加一样的长尾。字形必须一眼认对，统一而不雷同，没有任何纹理、飞白或书法装饰点。
B.explanation: reusable word-agnostic design grammar; not adapted per-character

predefined_validation.first: single downloadable PNG per arm, exact text, only four chars horizontal, native transparent alpha, no scenery or supporting text
predefined_validation.then: equal pixel and normalized ink height visual comparator, human unlabelled review pending
predefined_validation.invalid_if: either absent, malformed text, opaque background, poster, multiple subimages
predefined_validation.cross_glyph_transfer_claim: Only limited second phrase image generation candidate if BOTH technically valid. True style transfer requires independent aesthetic assessment, more examples, and a genuinely executable source-derived program.

confounds: R23 used per-character prompt whereas R24 B generalized; this is prompt-family transfer, not identical fixed prompt string.
R24 text was known as holdout and recorded before this run, but generalized grammar was formulated after R23 result; zero R24 pixel peeking, no full double blindness.
B has more adjectives/instructions than neutral baseline, and model/seed unknown.
